thread:
Aaron S (AE): need quick sign-off — Meridian Health wants an 8-week technical pilot. They asked for 60% off hosted API list pricing to run protos across 30 clinics. Estimated usage: ~300k tokens/day, committed $30k/mo for pilot. procurement is pushing timeline, they want pricing in the SOW.
Nina (RevOps): 60% is well above our pilot exception thresholds. what is the business case for that depth?
Aaron S (AE): reasons: (1) highly regulated customer, conversion to Dedicated very likely after security review, (2) if we don't give big enough discount procurement stalls, they move to competitor, (3) pilot includes a statement of work to help with integration (so some services revenue). Sales forecast: 70% conversion probability to Dedicated; expected committed ARR post-conversion $85k/mo.
Marco (Finance): need unit economics. at 300k tok/day -> ~9M tokens/month. at list price token revenue would be X; what's our blended cost? also, are there any one-time services included?
Aaron S (AE): services: $12k one-time integration fee (covers SOW). internal calc: our marginal cost ~= $0.025 per 1k tokens => pilot infra cost ~ $225/mo, negligible vs discount. biggest risk: churn after pilot.
Priya K: two levers: cap duration, or staged discount (e.g., 35% first 2 weeks, 50% remaining), or retro-credit on conversion. which reduces risk?
Sana (Legal): if we go beyond 30% must update T&Cs and include clear rollback language & no automatic renewal at discounted rate. also require data handling addendum for PHI if they will test with de-identified patient records. NDA copy required.
Nina (RevOps): propose: provisional 40% pilot discount, with a 60% effective credit applied only if they sign Dedicated within 120 days of pilot end. require $12k integration paid up front and a signed SOW + NDA. RevOps will track in SFDC with tag MER-PLT-2026.
Marco (Finance): I can accept provisional 40% only. to approve any >40% need VP Finance signoff. conditions: deal-desk form, RevOps workflow created, legal amendment drafted, and services paid.
Aaron S (AE): can we do 40% + $12k services now and then automatic retro-credit to bring to 60% if they convert? customer insists on 60% shown in SOW to satisfy procurement.
Sana (Legal): we can draft wording: "pilot price shown as '60% off list', net payment collected reflects 40% discount; a post-signing credit equal to the differential (to reach 60%) will be issued upon execution of Dedicated contract within 120 days." will add data residency and PHI clauses.
dealbot: Reminder: pilot_discount_policy v2.1 — >30% requires Finance Dir + RevOps + Legal signoff. Upload deal desk here: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/new
Nina (RevOps): I'll create ticket FIN-4012 and the credit automation. Tagging SFDC: MER-PLT-2026.
Marco (Finance): provisional approval: 40% now. escalate to VP Finance for any 60% upfront. finance will sign final once deal-desk request is submitted and Legal provides amendment.
Aaron S (AE): filing deal-desk now and sending NDA to customer. will attach SOW and forecast. ETA docs by COB.
Priya K: good tradeoff. marking provisional 40% approved in-thread. please loop Marco and Sana when paperwork uploaded. :thumbsup:
